description: 👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.
summary: Ghostty is the terminal I've been reaching for lately because the multi-threaded per-terminal architecture (dedicated read, write, and render threads) plus a SIMD-optimized parser make it genuinely snappy even when I've got a dozen agent sessions spitting output across PenguPool panes. What sold me past the speed claim is libghostty, a zero-dependency C and Zig library you can embed in your own app to get a standards-compliant terminal widget, which is exactly the kind of composable primitive I want when I'm gluing small local tools together rather than shipping a monolith. The fact that the macOS build is a real SwiftUI app with a Metal renderer instead of a cross-platform web wrapper tells me the people writing it care about the native, local experience the same way I do.
